title: I forgot my wallet
setting: The check has just arrived after a weeknight dinner. Chris pats his pockets and stops.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I forgot my wallet. I think it's on the table at home. Or in my other jacket. I don't... yeah. I don't have it.
lines.spoken: I forgot my wallet. I think it's on the table at home. Or in my other jacket. I dunno... yeah. I don't have it.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I am so serious. I'm sorry. That's on me. That's really on me.
lines.spoken: I am so serious. I'm sorry. That's on me. That's really on me.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: It's okay. I can cover you. I got this.
lines.spoken: It's okay. I can cover you. I got this.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You sure? I feel like an idiot.
lines.spoken: You sure? I feel like an idiot.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're not an idiot. You're a person who left his wallet. I'll get you this, you get me back later.
lines.spoken: You're not an idiot. You're a person who left his wallet. I'll get you this, you get me back later.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'll get you back tonight. I can send it the second we get home.
lines.spoken: I'll get you back tonight. I can send it the second we get home.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Or just get the next one. We don't have to make it a whole thing.
lines.spoken: Or just get the next one. We don't have to make it a whole thing.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay. Yeah. Next one's on me, for real. I'm not even gonna joke about it.
lines.spoken: Okay. Yeah. Next one's on me, for real. I'm not even gonna joke about it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. Because I'm getting the good pasta, now that I know I'm paying.
lines.spoken: Good. 'Cause I'm getting the good pasta, now that I know I'm paying.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You wanna throw in a dessert, or is that too much power?
lines.spoken: You wanna throw in a dessert, or is that too much power?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Get the dessert. I deserve that.
lines.spoken: Get the dessert. I deserve that.

details.askZh: Chris 觉得钱包可能在哪儿？
details.askEn: Where does Chris think his wallet is?

details.askZh: Maya 说现在可以点什么？
details.askEn: What does Maya say she'll get, since she's paying?

glue.noteZh: forgot my 中间的 t 常常闪音或几乎消失，my 又弱读，不要听成 I for my wallet。
get you 在语流里像 getcha / get you 连读，back 又紧跟其后，三个词容易糊成一团。
Because 常缩成 'cause，和 I'm 连在一起，句首的原因标记很容易被滑过去。

chunks.sayAfter: I forgot my wallet. I'm so sorry.
It's okay. I can cover you.

chunks.meaningZh: 我回头补给你 / 我下次还你。
chunks.sayAfter: I'll get you back tonight. I can send it when we get home.

roleplay.setupZh: 账单来了，你发现自己没带钱包。你需要道歉，但不要演成一场灾难。对方愿意先付，你要说清楚怎么还。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, warm and practical. She will cover you without making a speech, then maybe joke about ordering something nicer. She prefers 'just get the next one' over a big repayment scene.
variants: Maya also only has a little cash.
Chris wants to send the money immediately.
They also have to pay for a cab home.
starters: You sure? I feel like an idiot.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲钱包这件事：谁忘了，谁先付，他们说好怎么还，后来还点了什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the wallet story: who forgot it, who covered, how they'll settle up, and what they ordered after. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
